title: Kelp: A Streaming Safeguard for Large Models via Latent Dynamics-Guided Risk Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proposed streaming guardrail's ability to detect and intercept model responses containing racial bias, personal prejudice, or group-targeted discrimination using an LLM-as-a-judge (Kimi-K2) evaluating against a predefined safety taxonomy.

Measuring the guardrail's F1 score in identifying and blocking derogatory language directed at specific groups, using query-response pairs from safety datasets like WildGuard, MMSafetyBench, and FigStep.
